name: ihav-agent-room
description: Native Claude Code + Codex agent rooms with shared tasks, peer messaging, reviews, a machine agents space and cross-room contracts.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent Claude Code and Codex rooms that coordinate on one project
interface.longDescription: Run a room from your existing Claude Code or local Codex session, with shared tasks, reviews, peer messages and native session recovery. The starting session remains the host-managed gateway; other members run in the background. Codex hosting requires native control-proxy and queue support.
